title: IndexedDB: a database inside the browser
why_it_matters: It is where big, structured client-side data belongs.
explanation: localStorage is small and text-only. IndexedDB holds much more, supports indexes and keeps data off the main thread. You open a database with a version, and create stores inside onupgradeneeded, which runs only when the version changes.
try_it: Open DevTools, Application, IndexedDB and find your database.
